name: High Hills
author: Addicting Games
description: High Hills is a racing game. Move fast and move often. In High Hills, you're a 4x4 jeep trecking their way across the northwest. Hop in and slam on the accelerator as you navigate the hills and valleys of this sprawling racing game. Collect coins in order to buy upgrades for your offroader so you can fully optimize your ability to trek and explore. Tame the wild with the sheer will power of your steely nerved determination as you jump, swerve, and flip your way to victory. Earn extra points by flipping, spinning and jamming your way into the future. You may be stuck behind the wheel of a 4x4 but that doesn't mean you can't explore the world.
